correctness.rationale: Independently reconstructed the complete 72-state transfer matrix from maps (a,b)->(a,a+b),(a+b,b) mod 9 and exactly checked its degree-72 characteristic factorization with SymPy. The sextic q was independently verified irreducible mod 17; evaluating R(E)C at zero from exact integer recurrence gave 116619264, proving the q-mode occurs. Independent complex root calculations gave maximal pair modulus 1.439066724563126 and secondary pair 1.4081559256090412; actual check_stern9.py was inspected for exact rational Rouché-center certificates, so root separation is not inferred only from floats. Perron eigenvalue 2 is simple and uniform projection contributes exactly 2^k/72. Standard rational generating-function root growth gives limsup, not pointwise lower bounds.
